steps.title: Gather Requirements for Modern Calculator
steps.description: Analyze target SDK versions, core functional requirements, and visual styling guidelines.

steps.title: Define Metadata
steps.description: Generate app-meta.json with app name and package namespace details.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Settings
steps.description: Build-out AGP 8.3.2 and Gradle 8.5 configurations targeting compileSdk 34.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Define standard application rules, launch settings, package context, and orientation configuration.

steps.title: Design Custom Number Button Selector
steps.description: Implement XML state list shape for standard numerical calculator buttons.

steps.title: Design Custom Operator Button Selector
steps.description: Implement XML state list shape for calculator arithmetic operators.

steps.title: Design Custom Action Button Selector
steps.description: Implement XML state list shape for utility calculator actions.

steps.title: Create Main Application Layout
steps.description: Construct UI containing dynamic display areas and 5 rows of input actions using nested LinearLayout configurations.

steps.title: Initialize Java Code Structure
steps.description: Implement main package setup, interface bindings, and views tracking in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Implement Mathematical Evaluator Parser
steps.description: Write custom standard Java expression tokenizer and grammar interpreter supporting standard operators without third party libraries.

steps.title: Add Input Rules and History Support
steps.description: Implement logic for decimal dots, clearing operations, percent modifiers, dynamic display scaling, and historical display caching.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Run the Gradle compile assemble task to generate a debug build output file.
